sources.finding: Retained full PhilFCT catalog reviewed. Existing canned and specialized recipes do not represent the proposed home-prepared ingredient mixtures.
Official recipe nutrition is per stated serving, e.g. cups/pieces. No gram-weight mapping used; did not convert its nutrient values to per 100 g.
Nutrition basis ambiguous relative to dish-only serving and meal-serving idea; not imported.

decision: Build clearly labeled model-designed ingredient mixtures instead; all recipe weights/yields assumed, no published recipe nutrition imported.
